title: Deployment evidence: what may satisfy a DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED readiness row
note: D-2026-155. Each mutation deletes one rule of tools/deployment_evidence.py: a refusal of an attestation, of a deployment policy, of where either lies, of the signature or of the verifier label, or the tree check against committed evidence. tests/test_deployment_evidence.py pairs every refusal with an attestation that passes every other check.

mutations.name: DE1_any_environment_is_production
mutations.rationale: a test or staging deployment's evidence is taken as production evidence

mutations.name: DE2_any_deployment_is_covered
mutations.rationale: an attestation about a deployment the owner's policy does not cover is accepted

mutations.name: DE3_another_commit_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: evidence about another implementation is accepted as evidence about this one

mutations.name: DE4_an_expired_attestation_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: an attestation past its validity is accepted

mutations.name: DE5_a_future_observation_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: an attestation observed at a time that has not happened is accepted

mutations.name: DE6_validity_is_unbounded
mutations.rationale: an attestation may claim validity past the owner's bound

mutations.name: DE7_a_failed_check_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a control whose check failed satisfies its row

mutations.name: DE8_the_wrong_check_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a control reporting some other check satisfies the row

mutations.name: DE9_any_row_may_be_attested
mutations.find: if row is None or row.get("status") != "DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED":
mutations.rationale: a deployment attests a row the matrix holds as hosted-tested or blocked

mutations.name: DE10_an_empty_attestation_is_accepted
mutations.find: if not isinstance(controls, dict) or not controls:
mutations.rationale: an attestation covering no control validates

mutations.replace:
if False:

mutations.name: DE12_a_policy_beside_the_attestation_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: the deployment supplies the policy that judges its own evidence

mutations.name: DE13_an_attestation_in_the_repository_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a JSON status the repository wrote about itself is accepted as deployment evidence

mutations.name: DE14_a_ci_identity_may_attest
mutations.rationale: this repository's CI or agent workflow is accepted as a deployment's attester

mutations.name: DE15_a_pattern_may_name_the_attester

mutations.name: DE16_the_trusted_root_is_not_pinned
mutations.rationale: a trust configuration other than the one the owner pinned is used

mutations.name: DE17_an_expired_policy_is_accepted

mutations.replace:

mutations.name: DE18_the_signature_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
OV.sigstore_check(bundle, attestation, signer, mode="offline",

                          sigstore_python=sigstore_python)

mutations.name: DE19_a_test_verifier_is_reported_as_sigstore
mutations.rationale: evidence a test verifier accepted is labelled production evidence

mutations.name: DE20_a_committed_attestation_is_not_noticed
mutations.rationale: an attestation or deployment policy committed to the repository goes unnoticed

mutations.name: DE21_validity_bound_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a policy may let attestations live for years

mutations.name: DE22_any_policy_label
mutations.rationale: a policy that does not say it is a deployment trust root is accepted
